newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank to raise mandatory reserves Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank to raise mandatory reserves Feb 28.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland will raise on February 28 mandatory reserves on zloty call deposits by three points to 20 percent and on currency deposits by two points to four percent, the bank said in a Monday statement.

"Due to the Finance Ministry's sale of 2.2 billion zlotys of T-bills on December 30 which will cause a much larger money supply growth in 1997 than agreed with the government and parliament, the NBP decided to raise the rate of obligatory reserves...as of February 28...," the statement said.
"The protection of the zloty's position required also the rise of obligatory reserves on currency deposits, to counter the rise in currency savings," the statement said.
